name: Pizarra (Spain)
description: Light blue field with a white cross throughout, its horizontal arm edged purple above and green below, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Pizarra (a castle on red and a lion on white above vine leaves).
history: Municipal flag of Pizarra; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: stripe edging the upper side of the horizontal arm
stripe edging the lower side of the horizontal arm
Pizarra arms — castle on red, lion on white above vine leaves
